note: Every source below must be pulled and read by Matthew before any floors file leaves the review queue. Ids are stable and referenced by floors.lmc and floors.navigator. Do not add a floor without a source id; do not delete a source id that a floor references (CI checks referential integrity).

zubler2022.citation: Zubler JM, Wiggins LD, Macias MM, et al. Evidence-Informed Milestones for Developmental Surveillance Tools. Pediatrics. 2022;149(3):e2021052138.
zubler2022.role: Backbone for typical-range framing and the 2022 CDC milestone revision (75th-percentile norming). Public-domain checklist derivative (CDC LTSAE).

cdc_ltsae.citation: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early. Developmental Milestones (2022 revision).
cdc_ltsae.role: Public-domain milestone checklists; citable and reproducible.

filipek1999.citation: Filipek PA, Accardo PJ, Baranek GT, et al. The screening and diagnosis of autistic spectrum disorders. J Autism Dev Disord. 1999;29(6):439-484.
filipek1999.role: Origin of the canonical absolute red flags: no babbling by 12m, no gesturing by 12m, no single words by 16m, no two-word spontaneous phrases by 24m, any loss of language or social skills at any age.

aap_referral.citation: AAP / Bright Futures periodicity and developmental surveillance guidance (Lipkin & Macias, Promoting Optimal Development, Pediatrics 2020;145(1):e20193449).
aap_referral.role: Surveillance-to-screening-to-referral pathway; supports the always-route-to-conversation posture.

rescorla1989.citation: Rescorla L. The Language Development Survey: a screening tool for delayed language in toddlers. J Speech Hear Disord. 1989;54(4):587-599.
rescorla1989.role: Late-talker criterion: fewer than 50 expressive words or no word combinations at 24 months.

noritz2013.citation: Noritz GH, Murphy NA, and AAP Neuromotor Screening Expert Panel. Motor delays: early identification and evaluation. Pediatrics. 2013;131(6):e2016-e2027.
noritz2013.role: Motor floors: sitting, weight-bearing, walking outer bounds; early strong hand preference before 12 months as a flag; asymmetry as a priority flag.

jcih2019.citation: Joint Committee on Infant Hearing. Year 2019 Position Statement. Journal of Early Hearing Detection and Intervention. 2019;4(2):1-44.
jcih2019.role: Hearing posture: caregiver concern about hearing alone warrants audiological referral at any age; no wait-and-see for hearing.

flipsen2006.citation: Flipsen P Jr. Measuring the intelligibility of conversational speech in children. Clin Linguist Phon. 2006;20(4):303-312.
flipsen2006.role: Intelligibility expectations underpinning the stranger-intelligibility floor at 36m+.

zwaigenbaum2015.citation: Zwaigenbaum L, Bauman ML, Stone WL, et al. Early identification of autism spectrum disorder: recommendations for practice and research. Pediatrics. 2015;136(Suppl 1):S10-S40.
zwaigenbaum2015.role: Response to name by 12m, joint attention and pointing-to-show expectations, regression as a priority flag.
